column3: “in the case of Baal-peor” renders “at Baal-peor”; “all the men” renders “every person.”
“so near … as is” renders “near to it like”; “whenever we call” renders “in all our calling.”
“keep your soul” renders “guard yourself”; “your sons and your grandsons” renders “your children and your children’s children.”
NASB supplies “Remember” at the start; “on the earth” renders “on the land.”
“at the foot of the mountain” renders “under the mountain.”
“the Ten Commandments” renders “the ten words”; NASB supplies “that is.”
“watch yourselves carefully” renders “take great heed to your souls.”
“a people for His own possession” renders “a people of inheritance.”
“on your account” renders “because of your words.”
“against which the LORD … has commanded you” renders “which the LORD … commanded you.”
“have remained long” renders “grow old”; “an idol” renders “an image.”
Close to the Hebrew; “live long” renders “prolong days.”
“if you search” renders “for you will seek”; “soul” renders “being.”
“the latter days” renders “the end of the days.”
